findings.evidence: `rg` finds the component lemmas already present: `SymmetricEnergy.lean:72 energyIntegrand_zero_drift_flip_eq_of_isSymm`, `:115 energyIntegrand_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_flip_eq`, `:131 energyIntegrand_zero_drift_flip_eq_on`, `:137 energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass_flip_eq`; `CoerciveEnergy.lean:160 isCoercive_energyIntegrand_zero_drift`, `:182 isCoercive_energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass`; `UniformEllipticEnergy.lean:219 isCoercive_energyIntegrand_zero_drift`, `:232 isCoercive_energyIntegrand_zero_drift_on`; `UniformEllipticity.lean:571 UniformlyEllipticOn.coefficientSymmetricPart`.
findings.fix: Remove these wrappers and have consumers use the existing lemmas directly, e.g. `⟨energyIntegrand_zero_drift_flip_eq_of_isSymm ha c₀, isCoercive_energyIntegrand_zero_drift hlam hc hA⟩`, `⟨energyIntegrand_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_flip_eq A c₀, isCoercive_energyIntegrand_zero_drift hlam hc (fun ξ => by simpa using hA ξ)⟩`, `⟨energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass_flip_eq c, isCoercive_energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass hc⟩`, and for field versions combine `energyIntegrand_zero_drift_flip_eq_on`, `UniformlyEllipticOn.isCoercive_energyIntegrand_zero_drift(_on)`, and `h.coefficientSymmetricPart`.
findings.issue: All seven new declarations are thin `∧`-bundles of existing public lemmas: lines 57, 71, 82, 97, 106, 119, and 129 duplicate the separate symmetry/coercivity API.

summary: The new file adds only public conjunction wrappers around already-public symmetry and coercivity lemmas, creating a parallel API rather than new reusable material.
